}}Mistress '''Wellin''' is a clerk in the [[White Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wellin, Mistress}}

==Appearance==
Mistress Wellin is a stout woman. She wears her gray hair in a roll at the nape of her neck.

==History==
Mistress Wellin and [[Martan]] were assigned to copy lists gather by [[Accepted]] during the White Tower's census. They arrive at their workplace and find [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] already doing the task. Mistress Wellin complains to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Tamra Ospenya]], but the Amyrlin lets Moiraine and Siuan continue.{{ref/book|0|6}}
